verdict.rationale: Metorial is infrastructure for connecting AI agents/MCP clients to third-party tools and data sources; the evidence shows session/trace logging for human review (metorial-docs-10) but no feature where Metorial itself generates AI-driven insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. Sample bots (metorial-docs-26/27/28) are external workflows users build with LLMs, not built-in product insights.
